title: cacalia pumila
intro: Cacalia pumila, commonly known as dwarf cacalia or small Indian borage, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, thanks to its potential health benefits such as lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia pumila include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its ability to protect against cell damage and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
